content.title: Case Update
content.description: Restricted public-submission update for the reported vehicle connected with Maya Chen’s disappearance.

items.title: Camera evidence card
items.summary: Open the evidence card associated with the recorded vehicle arrival.

items.title: Check property directory
items.summary: Search the commercial property directory for the address shown in the evidence.

items.title: Report verified location
items.summary: Open the case location review after checking the property and unit records.

discovery.cue: Open starting page displays this case update.
discovery.linkReason: The police supplied this case-update page to the reporting party.

content.title: Camera Record
content.description: Police camera evidence card for a van arrival recorded at the property.

blocks.heading: Vehicle camera update
paragraphs: A city camera captured the reported van arriving at the listed property. Scan the machine-readable code on the evidence card to recover its record identifier.

discovery.cue: Click the visible Camera evidence card action.
discovery.linkReason: The case update publishes the evidence card as an attached case record.

content.title: Police Location Report
content.description: Review the corroborated property and unit before sending a location to police.

blocks.heading: Location review
paragraphs: This page records the property street address and separately verified unit designation in machine-readable review metadata before submission. Inspect the page source to recover the verified-location value.

items.title: Send location to police
items.summary: Open the case form and enter the complete reviewed location.

discovery.cue: Use the Report verified location link in the case action list after confirming the unit.
discovery.linkReason: The case portal navigation provides the police location-review action.

content.title: Send Police the Verified Location
content.description: Send the full property address and corroborated unit to the case team.

blocks.heading: Location submission
paragraphs: Enter the reviewed location exactly as shown on the location report. Include the street address and unit designation in the single Location field.

discovery.cue: Click Send location to police on the reviewed report.
discovery.linkReason: The reviewed location record offers the evidence-submission form as its next case action.

content.title: About the Case Portal
content.description: How River City Police accepts and reviews public case information.

blocks.heading: Portal purpose
paragraphs: The portal gives authorized reporting parties access to selected case updates and secure evidence forms. It does not publish full case files.

blocks.heading: Before sending information
items: Use only records you can identify.
Do not contact a suspect or enter a private property.

discovery.cue: Use the About link in the footer.
discovery.linkReason: The portal footer provides standard service information.

content.title: Evidence Submission Guide
content.description: Basic requirements for records sent through the case portal.

blocks.heading: Accepted details
rows: Street address and unit when available
Use the date and time printed by the source

blocks.heading: Safety
paragraphs: Send records through the portal. Do not visit a location or attempt to verify occupancy in person.

discovery.cue: Use the Evidence guide link in secondary navigation.
discovery.linkReason: The case portal provides general submission requirements.

content.title: Privacy Notice
content.description: How information submitted through the portal is handled.

blocks.heading: Information handling
items: Submissions are attached to the relevant case record.
Access is limited to authorized staff.
Contact details are not shown on public case updates.

discovery.cue: Use the Privacy link in the footer.
discovery.linkReason: The police portal publishes a standard privacy notice.

content.title: Contact Information
content.description: Routine contact options for River City Police.

discovery.cue: Use the Contact link in the footer.
discovery.linkReason: The portal includes routine agency contact details.

content.title: Commercial Property Directory
content.description: Search commercial properties managed by the Mason Street property office. Matched pages list all units, tenants, and assigned entrances.

blocks.heading: Property search
paragraphs: Enter a full street address in the Property address field. A matched property page includes current unit and entrance records. If there is no exact match, the form reports that no managed property was found.

items.title: Directory scope
items.summary: Read what the public directory includes and how records are maintained.

discovery.cue: Click Check property directory on the police case update.
discovery.linkReason: Police cite the property office directory so reporters can verify a unit before submitting a location.

content.title: Warehouse Unit Directory
content.description: Complete tenant and assigned-entrance listing for the matched commercial property.

blocks.heading: Matched property
paragraphs: The result contains every commercial unit at the matched address in numeric order. Compare the tenant rows with the carried company filing.

items.title: Northline Survey tenant registry record
items.summary: View the dated lease record and assigned entrance for the matching tenant.

discovery.cue: Type the filing’s street address into the Property address field to receive the complete matching property record.
discovery.linkReason: The directory resolves exact managed-property addresses to their complete unit listings.

content.title: Northline Survey Tenant Registry Record
content.description: Dated property-office versions for an active commercial lease.

blocks.heading: Record history
paragraphs: Compare the January and August versions to find the responsible manager in the latest annual review.

items.title: Rear loading entrance notice
items.summary: Open the official dated notice associated with this lease’s entrance assignment.

discovery.cue: Use the Tenant registry record link on the matching tenant row.
discovery.linkReason: The property record provides navigation to the active tenant’s dated registry record.

content.title: Entrance Assignment Notice
content.description: Property-office notice for the assigned rear loading entrance.

blocks.heading: Rear loading entrance assignment
paragraphs: Read the dated notice and identify the unit number shown in the large monospace lettering.

discovery.cue: Use the Rear loading entrance notice link beside the entrance assignment.
discovery.linkReason: The tenant record provides navigation to the official entrance-assignment notice.

content.title: About the Directory
content.description: Scope and maintenance of the commercial property directory.

blocks.heading: Coverage
paragraphs: The directory covers commercial properties managed by the Mason Street property office. Each matched property shows every current unit, listed tenant, and assigned public or service entrance.

blocks.heading: Record maintenance
items: Entrance changes are published as dated notices.
Vacant units remain listed to keep unit sequences complete.

discovery.cue: Click Directory scope on the search page.
discovery.linkReason: The directory search page links to its coverage statement.

content.title: Tenant Records
content.description: How active commercial tenant records are published.

blocks.heading: Published fields
rows: Shows whether the listing is active
Names the current office contact after review
Links the unit to an official entrance notice

blocks.heading: Versions
paragraphs: When an annual review changes a published field, the prior dated version remains available from the tenant record.

discovery.cue: Use Tenant records in primary navigation.
discovery.linkReason: The directory explains its tenant-record publication policy.

content.title: Entrance Assignment Policy
content.description: How entrances are assigned and documented for warehouse units.

blocks.heading: Assignment rules
items: Each occupied unit has one listed routine entrance.
Shared loading areas require a dated office notice.
Changes take effect on the date printed on the notice.

blocks.heading: Public notices
paragraphs: A tenant record links to the current notice when a service entrance is assigned.

discovery.cue: Use Entrance policy in secondary navigation.
discovery.linkReason: The directory publishes routine property-access rules.

content.title: Property Office
content.description: Contact and service information for the commercial directory.

blocks.heading: Requests
items: Ask about a directory search that returned no match.

discovery.cue: Use Property office in the footer.
discovery.linkReason: The directory includes routine publisher contact information.
